s: Seder tepillat arbit shel pesach ubo ch' seipim: bekol yamim tobim arbit shacharit umincha, mitpallel shelosha berakot rishonot ushelosha acharonot ubirkat qedushshat hayyom baemtza, dehaynu sheyyizkor inyan qedushshat hayyom bitchillat habberaka, ubesopah samuk lachatima, kede sheyyihyeh meen chatima samuk lachatima, veyachtom "meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim", lepi sheyyisrael hem meqaddeshin hazzemannim al pi qebiut hachodashim hammasur beyadam. Veap im lo amar hannosach mammash shettiqqenu chakamim, dehaynu "atta bechartanu ku'", "vattitten lanu ku'", "vehassienu ku'" — yatza, veen machazirin oto im (hizkir qedushshat hayyom beemtza habberaka, kegon shehitchil habberaka be"yaaleh veyabo", shemmazkir sham qedushshat hayyom: "lechayyim uleshalom beyom chag ku'", vegam) chatam "meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim". Abal im (lo hizkir kelal qedushshat hayyom beemtza habberaka qodem hachatima, o apillu amar kol hannosach shettiqqenu chakamim, ella shebbachatima) taa velo amar "meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim", ella chatam beinyan acher, vaapillu taa vechatam "meqaddesh hashshabbat", ap al pi sheggam yom tob niqra shabbat, ap al pi ken kevan sheshshinna mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim beiqqar inyan habberaka — lo yatza, vetzarik lachazor lerosh otah beraka im nizkar leachar sheshshaha kede dibbur achar chatimato. Abal im nizkar betok kede dibbur — yachazor veyomar miyyad "meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim", velo yachazor larosh:

Abal mi shettaa vehitpallel y"ch shel chol beyom tob, im hizkir yom tob bibraka achat mehen, kegon sheamar "yaaleh veyabo" baaboda, vehizkir sham yom tob zeh — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor larosh ap al pi shello hizkir yom tob beshum chatima, lepi shello shinna mimmatbea shettabeu beiqqar inyan haaboda, shehare min haddin haya rauy lehitpallel kol y"ch beyom tob veshabbat kemo bechol raq lehazkir qedushshat hayyom bibraka achat mehen, ella shehachakamim heqellu al haadam velo hitrichuhu beyom tob lehitpallel kol y"ch, veqabeu beraka achat bilbad bishbil qedushshat hayyom, kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"ch. Abal im lo hizkir beshum beraka — lo yatza, apillu beyom tob sheni:

Im chal yom tob beshabbat — tzarik lehazkir gam qedushshat shabbat bitchillat habberaka, dehaynu sheyyomar "vattitten lanu ku' et yom hashshabbat hazzeh" kepi nuschatenu, o "et yom hammanoach hazzeh" kepi nuschaot acherim, vesamuk lachatima tzarik lomar: "shabbat umoade ku'", veyachtom "meqaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim" kepi nuschatenu, o "yisrael" belo va"v kepi nuschaot acherim. Abal lo yachtom "meqaddesh yisrael vehashshabbat vehazzemannim", lepi shehashshabbat hi qedosha meeleha shello al yede yisrael. Veim lo (amar "atta bechartanu" kelal, ella hitchil be"yaaleh veyabo", im hizkir bo shabbat — yatza. Abal im lo) hizkir shabbat bachatima, ap sheamar "atta bechartanu" vehizkir bo shabbat, vegam hizkiro beyaaleh veyabo — lo yatza, vetzarik lachazor larosh im nizkar leachar sheshshaha kede dibbur. Veken haddin im taa vechatam beshabbat bilbad. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheim chatam beyom tob bilbad o beshabbat bilbad — yatza, kevan shekkebar hizkir shenehem beemtza habberaka qodem hachatima. Ap shello hizkir shenehem bachatima ella echad mehen — en bekak kelum bediabad, shehare mi shehitpallel y"ch shel chol, im hizkir yom tob beachat mehen, ap al pi shello chatam bah beyom tob — yatza bediabad, lepi shello shinna mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim benosach chatimat habberaka kesheomerah bechol vehayeta reuya gam ken beyom tob kemo shennitbaer, im ken hu haddin keshechatam beyom tob bilbad — hare lo shinna mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim benosach chatimat habberaka bekol yom tob. Veap shello hizkir bah shabbat, mikkol maqom hare kebar hizkiro beemtza habberaka, vegam chatamah bematbea shettabeu bo chakamim bekol yom tob, vegam hayyom hu yom tob. Veken keshechatam beshabbat bilbad — hare chatam bematbea shettiqqenu chakamim bekol shabbat, vegam hayyom shabbat hu, vegam yom tob hizkir kebar beemtza habberaka. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem shello lachazor larosh, shello lehaknis atzmo lide sepeq beraka lebattala:

Keshechal beshabbat — en hashsheliach tzibbur chozer lomar birkat meen sheba achar tepillat arbit, lepi shello nitqena ella bishbil oto sheecher labo lebet hakkeneset sheyyesayyem et tepillato beod shehashsheliach tzibbur omer beraka zo, kede shello yishshaer lebaddo bebet hakkeneset shello yuzzaq sham, kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"ch, velel pesach en tzarik lazeh, ki hu "lel shimmurim" min hammazziqin:

Keshechal beshabbat, yesh omerim sheen tzarik lehazkir shabbat be"yaaleh veyabo", kevan shekkebar hizkiro paam achat be"vattitten lanu" — lamma yachazor veyazkirennu be"yaaleh veyabo"? Shehare "yaaleh veyabo" lo nitqan kelal bishbil shabbat, ella bishbil yom tob. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik lachazor ulehazkiro lekattechilla be"yaaleh veyabo" kemo shechozer umazkir bo yom tob (sheeno domeh lerosh chodesh shechal beshabbat sheen mazkirin shabbat be"yaaleh veyabo", mittaam shennitbaer besiman tk"h). Vekisbara zo yesh linhog lekattechilla, shehare ap lassebara harishona en shum chashash issur im chozer umazkiro, velassebara haacharona tzarik lehazkir — nimtza keshemmazkir yotze yede shenehem. Abal bebirkat hammazon en tzarik lehazkir shabbat be"yaaleh veyabo", kevan shekkebar amar "retzeh" bishbil shabbat — lamma yazkirennu paam b'? Hare gam yom tob eno mazkir bebirkat hammazon ki im paam echad bilbad, dehaynu be"yaaleh veyabo", shennitqan bebirkat hammazon bishbil yom tob bilbad velo bishbil shabbat, kemo shennitqan "retzeh" bebirkat hammazon bishbil shabbat bilbad velo bishbil yom tob:

Keshechal beshabbat — nohagin bimdinot ellu lomar shene peamim "beahaba", dehaynu "vattitten lanu Hashem elohenu beahaba shabbatot limnucha ku' beahaba miqra qodesh ku'". Abal keshechal bechol omerim paam achat bilbad, dehaynu "beahaba moadim lesimcha ku'", "et yom chag hammatztzot hazzeh zeman cherutenu ku'". Biqtzat medinot omerim: "et yom chag hammatztzot hazzeh, et yom tob miqra qodesh hazzeh, zeman cherutenu zeker litziat mitzrayim ku'". Ubemusap shel chol hammoed nohagin sham lomar: "et yom miqra qodesh ku'", velo "yom tob", lepi shechol hammoed eno niqra yom tob. Ulepikak en lomar bechol hammoed bebirkat hammazon: "harachaman hu yanchilenu leyom shekkullo tob":

Nohagin sheen hashsheliach tzibbur meqaddesh bebet hakkeneset belel pesach ap bimqomot shennohagin leqaddesh sham bekol lel yom tob veshabbat kede lehotzi et mi sheen lo yayin bebeto leqaddesh alayv, mikkol maqom belel pesach en tzarik lazeh, sheen ani beyisrael sheen lo arba kosot belayla zeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"b. Veap im era sheen yayin bair velo shum mashqeh shehu chamar medina ki im bebet hakkeneset bilbad — ap al pi ken en leqaddesh alayv bebet hakkeneset kede lehotziam yede chobatam, shehare hem enam yotzeim beqiddush zeh kevan sheeno bimqom seudatam, utzerikim hem lachazor uleqaddesh bebetam al happat. Veen meqaddeshin bebet hakkeneset bekol lel yom tob veshabbat ella shello lebattel taqqanat qadmonim shettiqqenu leqaddesh bebet hakkeneset bimehem shehayu metzuyim orechim lishbot bebet hakkeneset veleekol sham seudatam, ukesheen lahem yayin hem yotzeim beqiddush shebbebet hakkeneset shehu bimqom seudatam, kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"t. Ubelel pesach lo tiqqenu meolam leqaddesh bebet hakkeneset, lepi shehu dabar sheeno matzuy kelal shello yihyeh yayin lehaorechim, kevan sheen ani beyisrael sheen lo d' kosot:

Yesh meqomot nohagin ligmor hahallel betzibbur bibraka techilla vasop belel rishon shel pesach achar tepillat arbit, veken belel sheni shel galuyyot. Veen nohagin ken bimdinot ellu, sheen anu qorin kelal hahallel bebet hakkeneset belayla zeh:
